name: manual_fb2fd0
claim: When a receipt names a test run without listing its files, reconstruct the set from per-file counts at the exact head and match both the passed and the skipped totals to a named board row; label the result reconstructed, not confirmed, and say that the original record does not list the files.

decisions.notes: A ten-file receipt of 199 passed and 13 skipped was matched exactly by eight known files plus two named in a board row; the earlier nine-file run could not be reconstructed.

rationale: A ten-file receipt of 199 passed and 13 skipped was matched exactly by eight known files plus two named in a board row; the earlier nine-file run could not be reconstructed.
